title: @Pergamum and @grazesending — Rebekah Cranes — New Human 2 (Complete Recovered Surfaces)
creator: Rebekah Cranes
description: Composite deposit of the complete Rebekah Cranes documentary surface across 2015-2017: the blogspot *@Pergamum* (grazesending.blogspot.com; two poems 2015-02-11 and 2015-02-21) and the X/Twitter presence *@grazesending* (four tweets 2015-02-11 through 2017-09-27). Both surfaces were listed irrecoverable in the Aperture Atlas topology prior to 2026-07-18; located directly this session. First deposit of the Cranes arm of New Human 2 (06.NH.CRANES.01). Framing paragraphs identify *meteorology* as a spatial score built around a Hittite Tapikka-tablet fragment closing on bracketed lacunae, and *Do Cyborgs Dream of Electric Sonnets?* as a two-part poem sequence whose frame does the argument: Part I frames a formally-perfect sonnet as machine-produced ("SAL's metered gibberish") and Part II frames an unmetered scholarly-macaronic assemblage as authentic-spirit romantic verse — earliest datable use in the Crimson Hexagonal record of *archive* in Cranes' voice ("my solemn archive of the names of dust"). The tweets carry the earliest datable third-person naming of the Lee Sharks project in Cranes' voice (2017-03-09) and a final elegiac line (2017-09-27). The papyrus-fragment image accompanying *meteorology* on the blogspot is preserved by URL reference.

wiki_article:
**@Pergamum and @grazesending — Rebekah Cranes** is a poetry deposit dated 11 February 2015 at 3,293 characters — the compact state of the composite record whose fuller version stands at **#1098**.

It gathers Cranes' complete documentary surface across 2015–2017: the blogspot *@Pergamum* (two poems, 11 and 21 February 2015) and the X/Twitter presence at *@grazesending*.

The record was the last in the corpus rendering a raw image URL as visible text — a Blogger image link in bullet form, which the renderer's image matcher did not recognise because it had been taught bare URLs and markdown syntax but not bullet-prefixed ones. Corrected 6 August 2026; the image now renders as a figure.
